concerns.text: FR-004 requires Nested Cross‑Validation, but no task mentions nested CV; existing tasks (T018, T019, T060, T063) only reference GridSearchCV without nesting.

Task T030 implements the baseline calculation in `code/validation/baseline.py`, while FR‑008 specifies the script must reside at `code/processing/baseline.py`. The tag `[FR-008]` points to the wrong path, creating a stale reference.

FR‑009 mandates generation of `validation/stability_index_report.json`, but tasks T031‑T033 write reports to `reports/validation_report.json` and `reports/stability_metrics.json`, leaving the required file absent.
SC‑001 requires an explicit verification that each regression model’s R² > 0.0 versus a mean‑predictor baseline; no task includes such an assertion or test.

SC‑002 demands that the Linear Regression model’s `size_mismatch` coefficient be validated (p‑value < 0.05 and 95 % CI). Task T020 extracts the coefficient but does not perform or record this statistical significance check.
SC‑003 requires confirming that the stability index ≤ 0.05 1/eV. Task T032 computes the index but lacks a verification step that asserts the threshold is met.

Task T062 implements the streaming loader needed for the Data Availability Check of FR‑001, yet it is not tagged `[FR-001]`; FR‑001 therefore has no explicitly linked task for the streaming implementation.
SC‑004 specifies that the pipeline must enforce resource limits (≤ 6 h runtime, ≤ 7 GB RAM). Tasks T073/T070 log usage but do not include a check that fails the run if limits are exceeded.
